metricDefinitions.macroF1: Arithmetic mean of the invoice and report F1 values.
metricDefinitions.meanTrueLabelModelScore: Arithmetic mean of the model score assigned to each true label; this is not a calibration claim.
metricDefinitions.perClassF1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for one supported class, or zero when both are zero.
metricDefinitions.perClassPrecision: True positives divided by all predictions for one supported class, or zero when absent.
metricDefinitions.perClassRecall: True positives divided by all held-out samples for one supported class, or zero when absent.
